CustomField.description: ALF-RS-08 FR8c: a 3-Day (No Deposit) reservation held beyond the standard 3-day window requires manager approval. A rep sets this to the number of additional days they're requesting (added on top of the standard 3); leaving it blank or zero keeps the standard 3-day window with no approval needed. Ignored for 7-Day (Deposit) and VIP/Extended - the 7-day window is fixed by contract type, and VIP/Extended's period comes from the approving manager directly on AF_ExpiryDate__c, not from this field.
CustomField.label: Requested Extra Days (No-Deposit)
